profile.headline: Technologically-adept and award-winning IT professional: designing, developing, and delivering efficient software solutions with strong focus on optimal performance from requirement analysis to deployment phase.
profile.summary:
Hello and thank you for taking an interest in my profile!
Throughout my career, I have demonstrated success in spearheading production-ready projects. 

As per my stellar record, I have a track of developing software to fulfil user requirements, performing backend/frontend development activities, integrating unique features, and resolving complex technical problems for end-to-end business scenarios microservices including REST and Graphql. 
Talking about my expertise, I am £proficient in web/app development, database management, and architecting complex systems. 

Below are my specialty domains:
Software Development Life Cycle | Software Project Management | Design Integration | Strategic Planning & Execution | Process Optimization | Leadership & Team Development | Cross-functional Collaboration

In addition to above, I have a strong background of managing project workloads, prioritizing goals, and delivering support in code reviews. 

Lastly, I have a solid relationship-building expertise with ability to lead and communicate well with team members, clients, and users.

Should you have any questions regarding my career, please feel free to connect.

positions.title: Sr. Go Software Engineer
positions.description:
In my current role, I evaluate customer feedback and analyze system trends to drive key product decisions. 
I am responsible for proposing and implementing scalable improvements to systems and processes, resulting in enhanced efficiency and improving company's competitive position. 
I identify and resolve service and development issues by engaging with users. 
Moreover, I conduct comprehensive research on emerging technological advancements and vendor packages to align with market trends. 
I analyze user requirements and software needs to estimate design feasibility and budgetary constraints, whhile creating efficient flowcharts and layouts to determine software requirements and propose effective solutions. Coordinate installations for new systems and implement modifications to existing systems. 
I utilize version control systems to track code changes and resolve software bugs.
Key Contributions
•	Addressed and met customer needs effectively by conducting root cause analysis of recurrent system issues.
•	Developed prototypes and designs of new software applications in line with customer needs.
•	Orchestrated coaching and training sessions regular for newly hired software engineers.
•	Designed user interfaces for complex software applications.
•	Deployed software components for manual processes automation.
•	Led automation of system tasks through scripting and support tools.
positions.insights: Skills: Relational Databases · Go (Programming Language) · Scripting · Jira · Back-End Web Development · Microservices · Application Programming Interfaces (API) · Programming · Databases · Atlassian Suite

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
During this tenure, I have led implementation of GraphQL Web Services via Golang. Used React JS to build efficient front-end applications. 
I was accountable for utilizing Postgres and NoSQL databases for application development, as well as collaborated in development of cyber-oriented software for U.S. Army Cyber Command. 
I have implemented Git Version Control and adhered to the Github Flow model for unified code management.
Furthermore, I have applied Agile methodologies and delivered results within 2-week to 1-month-long sprints. 
Key Contributions
•	Participated in creation of responsive web application using React and Typescript as well as developed applications through AWS and Docker technologies.
•	Developed comprehensive unit tests to ensure code quality and optimize performance.
•	Steered software review processes under development for maximum client satisfaction.
•	Developed robust RESTful Microservice Web Services by leveraging Python.
•	Played key role in planning and designing of micro-service architecture by utilizing Golang and Python.
positions.insights: Skills: Relational Databases · Scripting · Jira · Application Programming Interfaces (API) · Programming · Databases · Atlassian Suite

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
During this tenure, I have established software solutions for outsourcing clients using C#, Java, Spring Boot, and ASP.NET Core. 
Also, I have developed microservices using Spring Boot to enhance scalability.
I have employed Agile SDLC Methodology to deliver code within set timelines. 
I have conducted thorough code reviews for fellow consultants to enable adherence to coding standards.
Key contributions
•	Minimized occurrence of bugs passed on to QA by directing implementation of Test-Driven Development.
•	Achieved maximum client satisfaction by leading software reviews throughout development process.

positions.title: Computer Ops Supervisor
positions.description:
While serving as a Computer Operations Supervisor, Governed development of efficient production software using C#, WCF, ASP.NET, and ASP.NET Core 2 with significant enhancement in operational productivity. 
I was responsible for assessing and rectifying all problems through innovative solutions incorporation for ensure uninterrupted productivity. 
Moreover, I have utilized IPSWITCH for seamless file transfer via FTP connections.
Key contributions
•	Drafted and drove batch files for multiple job completion and maximizing productivity.
•	Headed small team as well as maintained high productivity levels by meeting daily 8-hour deadlines.
•	Spearheaded collaborations between international departments to drive cross-functional initiatives towards achieving targets.
